Prairie Burner Weekly Gravel Ride

Grinnell, IA

Beginner friendly

Prairie Burner Weekly Gravel Ride is a gravel group ride in Grinnell, IA. It meets every Tuesday, 5:30 pm, starting at Bikes To You. Expect about 20–25 miles, routes posted ahead; shorter options some weeks.

About the Prairie Burner Weekly Gravel Ride group ride

A small-town weekly gravel ride from the Bikes To You shop, ending at Grinnell Craft Brewhouse. 20 to 25 miles on posted routes. Free loaner bikes through the Grinnell Bike Share. Not sure about gravel? The same group runs a shorter Gravel Curious ride Thursdays at 5:30 pm.
